name: Winter (Paragon Hag Family)
body:
Embodying the power and hunger of the coldest nights, winter hags live among the drifts and glaciers of polar regions. Their families gain the winter hags’ terrible connection with cold and ice.

Family Spells: endure elements (3rd), blindness/deafness (blindness only) (6th), sleet storm (9th), wall of ice (12th), cone of cold (15th), cold ice strike (18th)
Ritual Spells– Survival: communal protection from energy (5th), mirage arcana (7th), ice crystal teleport (9th), simulacrum (11th), extended control weather (13th), freedom (15th), sympathetic* temporal stasis (17th), sympathetic* imprisonment (19th)
Family Powers: Winter hag families grow increasingly connected to ice as their powers emerge.
Rime of Ice (Su)

You are covered with an unnatural frost, granting you resistance to cold 5, resistance to fire 5, and an armor bonus to your AC equal to your Charisma modifier. When you suffer fire damage exceeding your resistance, the frost is melted, removing all its benefits until it reforms in an hour.

Born of Winter (Ex)

At 4th level, you can see without penalty through snow and ice. Your rime grants resistance to cold 10. At 12th level, your rime grants resistance to cold 20. At 20th level, you are immune to cold.

Ice Sculpting (Su)

At 8th level, you can shape and mold ice with your hands, functioning as permanent stone shape on ice or snow. You can also climb as spider climb on any icy surface.

Ice Staff (Su)

At 12th level, you can spend a soul point as a move action to create a staff of black ice. The staff is as hard as steel, but crumbles when you next regain spells or if anyone other than a member of your coven attempts to use it. It functions as a +1 frost quarterstaff. At 16th and 20th level, the enhancement bonus on the staff increases by one.

Blinding Cold (Su)

At 16th level, you can invest your cold descriptor spells with the power to cause snow-blindness by spending a soul point. Whenever someone fails a save against that spell and takes cold damage, they are blinded for a number of rounds equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

Legendary Family

Upon reaching 20th level, your spells summon truly unbearable cold. When you would deal cold damage to a creature immune to cold, you still deal half damage. Your target’s resistance to cold is ignored. Your cold spells ignore evasion, stalwart, and improved evasion unless the target has at least as many hit dice as you have levels in paragon hag.
